Name: Robotriot
Overview: Bigger than a nanite! Smaller than a trash can! Feistier than a vengeful princess! Jump, puzzle and shoot thru spaceships and their systems as vanguard robot ‘SLUG’. Raid vessels for your galactic debt collecting master in pristine pixel perfection.Features:- universal application, so it works perfectly on both iPhone and iPad.- 12 action packed levels with more to come.- 13 enemy types, plenty of gun-turrets and epic bosses.- exciting power-ups and weapon-upgrades- classic platform action with unique.environmental hazards.- joyous retro style.
